verdict.rationale: Lindy's own MCP docs say you can point it at a hosted MCP server URL and it builds actions from the tools that server publishes, which is the core of this story. The documentation is brief and vendor-only. Missing for 10: details on authentication and configuration, support for local or stdio servers, per-tool controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Point Lindy at a hosted MCP server and it builds actions from the tools that server publishes.
you can hand Lindy the URL and it gains that product's tools without waiting for a native integration.
